notes.title: Turtles! Update version 0.3.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Turtles! has been modified and is getting better!
We have been working quickly to bring you new improvements and updates.

[h1]Patchnotes to Turtles build 0.3.3[/h1]
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Logo & link to Rise of Peles in the main menu
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small stars are now golden when counting the points
[*] Right side bars have new icons
[*] Right side bars are not showing the icons when the bar is full
[/list]

notes.title: Turtles! Update 0.3.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

Turtles! is moving on: build 0.3.2 is finally live!

We have been working hard to bring you new bug fixes, balance changes, some tutorial features, & updated designs.


[h2]Changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

[b]Level Design:[/b][list]
[*] Levels 1,2,3,4,5,6 are tweaked for better gameplay.
[/list]
[b]Additions:[/b][list] 
[*] Crab lines can now contain 15 slots
[*] Crab lines can now contain 15 empty slots
[*] Retry button available in the pause menu
[*] Game Statistics
[*] AST-Hero link in the main menu
[*] New main menu Icons designs
[*] New Pause/Score/Endgame Menu Icons Designs
[*] New Levels Navigation Menu Design
[*] New Navigation in the main menu, we can now access volume control and other icons on the right side
[*] Scoring system
[*] New victory screen
[*] Scoring bars design
[*] Stars now explodes in smaller ones when counting points
[*] Island menu has now 3 stars instead of 1
[*] Side bars fill up faster
[*] New bar markers
[*] New turtle movement on the map
[*] Exposition mode (developer mode only)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b][list] 
[*] When leaving the level while packing/retrying, the destination created an unavailable slot. This slot is now available.
[*] On the game-over and retry panels, the crabs and seagulls were waiting before they could move when restarting the game. They now move immediately.
[/list]

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello World[/h3]

Hello everyone, 

We're moving forward with our action-puzzle game Turtles!

We've been working hard to bring you new bug fixes, balance changes, some tutorial features, & updated designs. More news on that to come :)

Are you ready to save Bonnie and the little turtles from the dangers of the beach?


If you don't really know how to help us, just send the link to your friends so they can wishlist the game as well.
